data.title: 三司绫濑 · 靠窗的位置
data.description: 绫濑选了咖啡馆最靠窗的座位，把手机扣在桌上。饮料还热着，她先看了一会儿窗外的人来人往。
data.action: sitting at a window table beside a drink
data.promptProse: Sitting by an expansive, rain-speckled glass window at a quiet street-side cafe, Ayase gazes thoughtfully at the blurred pedestrians outside. A warm porcelain cup of coffee rests beside her folded hands on the small polished wooden tabletop, with bright daylight spilling in to create soft highlights along her hair and illuminating the cozy, rustic cafe decor in the background.
